title: Shared logical-layout semantics across SVG and Pixi
summary: Centralized hardware semantics so CPU and GPU rendering modes present consistent topology and interactions.

dates.note: Individual implementation dates are not established; the supplied engineering analysis is an October 5, 2026 snapshot.

facts.text: Rebuilt logical layout around shared hardware classification and metadata, with route-aware grouping for complex interconnect structures.
Centralized labels, colors, visibility, cursors and interaction behavior across SVG and Pixi rendering backends, with focused layout and renderer coverage.
Resolved logical-canvas connectivity and export/re-import defects involving ingress resolution, route highlights and persisted backing connections.

notes: Other engineers contributed shared scene and renderer architecture; this record describes Michael's documented changes.
